props.h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in India
props.pText: Discover top outdoor gym equipment manufacturers in India, specializing in high-quality fitness solutions for public parks and recreational areas. Here you can get park exercise equipment names and details about our offerings.

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in India

c: FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor gym equipment at our factory in Vasai East, in the Palghar district of Maharashtra. We have made play and fitness equipment since 2002 for parks, housing societies, schools, colleges and corporate campuses, and our work covers more than 15,000 installations across India. Our outdoor gym range is called Fun Fitness and sits within our CoreCraft line.

Every machine is made in our 45,000 sq ft facility by a team of 150+ people, who fabricate the galvanised frames and inspect each piece before dispatch. We send equipment by road to any state and install it with our own team or one of our dealers in the north, south, east and west of India. Wherever your site is, the steps stay the same. You share the size and photos, we send a layout drawing, and we manufacture once you approve it.

richText.heading: Outdoor gyms for every Indian climate

c: An open gym in Kochi faces a very different year from one in Jaipur or Shimla. Coastal cities bring salt air and humidity, and the Northeast and the Western Ghats bring months of heavy rain. The northern plains swing from fierce summers to foggy winters, while the desert belt adds dust and strong sun. Galvanised frames handle all of these well, because the zinc coating protects the steel from rust.

What changes from region to region is the base. Wet regions need a raised, well-drained platform, while dusty ones need moving parts wiped and checked more often. Our warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts, for equipment installed and maintained as per our instructions.

Municipal corporations usually want sturdy stations along walking tracks and in public parks. Housing societies want a compact corner, and schools, colleges and industrial townships want strength stations for younger users. The full

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to every state in India?
items.a: Yes. All equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sent by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer, and we have dealers in all four regions of India.

items.q: What warranty comes with your outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

items.q: Do outdoor gym machines need electricity or adjustment?
items.a: No. Our Fun Fitness machines work on the user's own body weight, so there is nothing to plug in or set. That makes them easy to use for walkers, students and senior citizens alike.

items.q: How do I get a quote for an outdoor gym?
items.a: Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with the size of the area, photos and the expected users. We will suggest machines and send a layout drawing with the quote.
